title: Bharatan Baingan Bharta
description: A popular Indian eggplant dish where eggplant is roasted, then mashed and seasoned with spices. Serve with rice or roti.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: any variety, preferably pretty and fluffy

instructions: Roast the eggplant in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until the skin is charred and the flesh is tender.
Let the eggplant cool down, then peel off the skin and mash it.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and sauté until they are translucent.
Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the garam masala and bharta masala and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the mashed eggplant and mix well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice or roti.
